platform: KWDC 93.5 Clean-MP3 Music Submission and Consent Route
manual_review_reason: KWDC's official Music Submissions page authorizes clean MP3 music by email to kwdc@deltacollege.edu and requires the subject Music Submission, sender and artist details, song title, a professional description, social or website links, a stereo master at -3 dB, and a signed music consent form or manually completed digital-signature workflow. A human must review and sign the legal consent, inspect the optional digital-sign route without bypassing any protection, select one suitable clean MarcsMusic master, confirm MP3, loudness and attachment requirements, international eligibility, rights, release timing and AI-origin policy, and manually send one reviewed submission. Do not automate the email, consent, signature or file transfer. Stop if authentication, CAPTCHA, payment, terms, session or other protected controls appear.
